result.summary: Both slots and all three R groups pass. Slot a (E on core day_corr(Ret, Amt)) gets novelty 3 and soundness 3. I struck 5 of its 13 seeds and 8 remain. Seeds 2, 3 and 5 are still head +0.61 under another name: raw rho 0.68 / 0.68 / 0.73 and residual 0.72 / 0.74 / 0.80, and the table strikes seed 5 at 0.73 anyway. Seeds 6 and 7 work out to roughly |K|, which the slot's own operator rules forbid: their correlation with liq and known jumps from about 0.02 for the core to about 0.25. Slot b (N on intraday time segments) gets novelty 4 and soundness 4 with no seeds struck: every seed is below 0.3 against all heads and at most 0.35 against the controls. Two caveats on b: the open_vwap15 label enters after the next open, so a close-to-open reversal cannot be captured; and the 2018-08-20 Shanghai closing-auction break makes the 60-day self-history z-scores act as an exchange dummy for about 60 days in train. The R groups score 4 / 3 / 3. The written audit is at /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/research/coldstart_C06/partura/s801/r3/audit_1.yaml.
